root_detector: Median darkRGBmax<80 in largest dense-body column interval; density threshold0.6*95thpercentile column occupancy. Used only for whole-pose registration, not to repaint art.
source_aspect_preserved: Whole-pose uniform scale, outputheight rounded to a whole pixel; silhouettewidth measured afterNearest. No per-axis stretch or limb/part editing.

metrics.method: BT709 gray; transparent RGB zeroed; scipy Sobel unnormalized/default reflect; inner binary alpha boundary; binary erosion default connectivity1
metrics.limits: No automatic visual/anatomy/animation verdict; run lengths do not alone measure perceived sharpness or prove a texel grid.

limits: Static master only; no animation/atlas/roster admission.
